Been working on a little project called RugRadar.
It's a free Grok bot that checks Solana tokens, looks into creator wallets and flags potential rug-pull risks.
Still early alpha, so expect a few rough edges.
Give it a try and let me know what you think.https://t.co/d8k9a2A4fF…
